blocks.text: Global K-pop powerhouse BLACKPINK has been removed from YG Entertainment’s list of artists under exclusive contracts, sparking speculation among fans worldwide. The omission appeared in the South Korean agency’s third-quarter business report filed on Monday, November 16. According to regulatory filings, only four acts were listed under exclusive contracts as of September 30. These remaining acts are BabyMonster, Winner, Treasure, and solo singer Eun Ji-won. READ: Blackpink’s 10th anniversary overshadowed by fan backlash, apologies BLACKPINK previously appeared on the roster in YG’s semi-annual report submitted in August.
